question: In shot put, the shot which is a metal ball weighs how many kg for men and women?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Men-7.26 kg Women-4 kg.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The shot put is an athletics event where athletes throw a metal ball or shot as far as possible.**
 
• The metal ball or shot used in shot put is made of brass, iron, or steel and has a smooth surface for a better grip.
 
• The weight of the metal ball or shot used in shot put varies for different age groups and gender categories.
 
• Shot put is a part of the track and field events in athletics.
 
• The metal ball or shot used in shot put has a diameter of 110-130 mm for men and 95-110 mm for women.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The hammer throw is one of the four throwing events in regular track and field competitions, along with the discus throw, shot put and javelin.
 
• In hammer throws events, athletes throw a metal ball (16lb/7.26kg for men, 4kg/8.8lb for women) that is attached to a grip by a steel wire no longer than 1.22m while remaining inside a seven-foot (2.135m) diameter circle. 
 
• In order for the throw to be measured, the ball must land inside a marked 35-degree sector and the athlete must not leave the circle before it has landed, and then only from the rear half of the circle. 
 
• The thrower usually makes three or four spins before releasing the ball.
